workflow_text:
# Workflow: TMT-labelcheck-229
# TMT Label Check with TMT6/10/11 mass (229.1629 Da)
# Used for TMT6, TMT10, TMT11 labeling efficiency QC
#
# Key difference from standard TMT workflow:
# - TMT is a VARIABLE modification (not fixed) to detect unlabeled peptides
# - MSBooster disabled for faster QC processing
# - calibrate_mass=0 (no MSFragger internal calibration, faster QC)
# - IonQuant runs with QC settings (no MBR, no MaxLFQ)
# - TMTIntegrator disabled (not quantifying TMT channels)
